hook: Twenty six percent of Americans now spend more money than they earn every single month.

sections.voiceover: Twenty six percent of Americans now spend more money than they earn every single month.
The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority published the National Financial Capability Study showing this decline. What else does the National Financial Capability Study reveal?
Credit cards' numbers tell an even worse story.
Cardholders paying balances in full dropped by 6 percentage points. This data comes from the sixth wave of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority study.
Twenty six percent of all Americans continue struggling with their monthly budgets.
